design_philosophy.core_concept: Digital Tactility. The app should feel like a physical artifact—a grimoire or a spread cloth—rather than a SaaS product.
key_principles: Texture over Flatness: Use grain, paper overlays, and noise to kill digital sterility.
Typography as Ornament: Headings are spells. Use them largely and decoratively.
Ritualistic Interaction: Animations should feel deliberate and weighted, not instant.
Lighting: Use shadows and glows to simulate candlelight or moonbeams.

headings.usage: Page titles, Card names, Major arcana highlights

ui_elements.usage: Buttons, Tooltips, Small labels (strictly limited use for legibility)

icons.special: Use 'Gi' (Game Icons) from 'react-icons/gi' for occult symbols (GiPentagram, GiCrystalBall, GiTarotCard)

buttons.primary: bg-gold-base text-ink-black font-ui uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-3 border-2 border-double border-ink-black hover:bg-gold-shimmer transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-ink-black border border-ink-faded font-ui uppercase tracking-widest px-6 py-2 hover:border-gold-base hover:text-gold-antique

cards.container: bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-gold-antique/30 p-6 rounded-sm shadow-lg
cards.tarot_card: aspect-[2/3] rounded-lg border-4 border-white/10 shadow-2xl relative preserve-3d cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500

inputs.petition: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-ink-faded/30 text-xl font-body italic text-center focus:border-gold-base focus:outline-none placeholder:text-ink-faded/50 py-4 w-full

layout_strategies.grid_system: Use a flexible Bento Grid for the dashboard/history. For the Tarot Spread, use a fixed, centered layout (Celtic Cross or 3-Card row).
layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. Use 'py-20' or 'py-32' for sections. The content needs to breathe.

animations.card_flip: RotateY 180deg. Duration 0.8s. Ease: [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] (Cubic Bezier for weight).
animations.fade_in: Opacity 0 to 1, Y +20px to 0. Stagger children by 0.1s.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards without heavy customization (remove white bg, add texture).
Avoid 'Inter' font everywhere. It breaks immersion.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA, especially on textured backgrounds.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Use 'sonner' for toasts, styled to look like parchment notes.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add @import for Cinzel Decorative, Cormorant Garamond, and Crimson Text in index.css immediately.
2. SETUP TAILWIND: Extend the theme with the colors provided in 'color_palette'. Add a 'texture' utility class for the paper overlay.
3. COMPONENT OVERRIDE: Modify Shadcn components to use the 'antique' aesthetic. No rounded-xl defaults. Use rounded-sm or rounded-md.
4. ANIMATION: Install 'framer-motion' if not present. It is required for the card flip.
5. TEXTURE: Create a global CSS class '.bg-texture' that applies the parchment image as a fixed overlay with 'mix-blend-mode: multiply' and low opacity.
